title: B2B Contact, WhatsApp & Tax ID Extractor Input
description: Provide company domains or URLs to enrich with verified emails (including Cloudflare de-obfuscation), WhatsApp Business numbers, phones, social links, and LATAM/EU tax IDs. Optimized for batch enrichment and Model Context Protocol (MCP) AI agents.

domains.title: Company URLs or Domains
domains.description: List of company websites or domains to extract B2B contact signals from (e.g., https://apify.com or example.com).

checkContactPages.title: Crawl Contact, About & Legal Subpages
checkContactPages.description: Automatically visits up to maxSubpagesPerDomain internal contact/about/legal pages (EN/ES/PT: /contact, /contacto, /nosotros, /aviso-legal, /fale-conosco).

maxSubpagesPerDomain.title: Max Subpages per Domain
maxSubpagesPerDomain.description: Maximum number of internal contact or legal subpages to inspect per company domain.

onlyWithContacts.title: Only Output Leads with Email, Phone, or WhatsApp
onlyWithContacts.description: When enabled, skips domains where no actionable contact channel (email, WhatsApp, or phone) was discovered.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrent Requests
maxConcurrency.description: Number of company domains to process concurrently.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: HTTP timeout per page fetch in seconds.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy settings for protected websites.
